question: Grove avocado oil manufacturer parent company
markdown:
Grove Avocado Oil is an independent boutique producer
headquartered in Te Puna, Bay of Plenty, New Zealand. It was founded by a local group of
regional avocado growers
and operates as a privately held independent company rather than a subsidiary of a larger multinational parent conglomerate.
